# alina schanz

> onchain data, notes and small scripts. berlin. numbers, not calls.

personal site of alina schanz, an onchain data analyst in berlin. english, lowercase on purpose. every number on the site comes from a public endpoint through a script published on github, python standard library only, no api keys.

## pages

- [home](https://alinaschanz.life/): live bitcoin and ethereum price, ethereum base fee, fear and greed, the latest note
- [notes](https://alinaschanz.life/notes/): longer notes on onchain data, one or two a month ([atom](https://alinaschanz.life/feed.xml), [json feed](https://alinaschanz.life/feed.json))
- [about](https://alinaschanz.life/about/): who, the disclosure (no paid posts, no calls, no trading around own notes, sources named, corrections stay visible), what she reads and uses, colophon
- [methods](https://alinaschanz.life/methods/): which endpoint and which formula produce each number, and what can go wrong
- [data](https://alinaschanz.life/data/): a daily dataset of the ethereum base fee (min, percentiles, max, cheapest hour), csv on github
- [scripts](https://alinaschanz.life/scripts/): the six repositories: onchain-notes, gasweek, bigmoves, stablepeg, ens-lookup, the site
- [verify](https://alinaschanz.life/verify/): the accounts that are her (x @alinaschanz, github alinaschanz, hello@alinaschanz.life), the ones that are not, the openpgp key 17BA4C393451A56B37B8EDBBF1A6474B431DF3AB, how to check a signed commit
- [privacy](https://alinaschanz.life/privacy/): no cookies, no analytics, no trackers, self-hosted fonts; which public apis the browser calls and a switch to turn them off
- [now](https://alinaschanz.life/now/), [changelog](https://alinaschanz.life/changelog/)
